limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the write-pointer increment but also changed the cycle-by-cycle timing of `wfull` and `rempty` by registering the flags and deriving the Gray pointers from next addresses, whereas the correct fix preserves the original status logic.
The scoreboard used the DUT’s own flags to decide which transfers counted and checked flag values after fill and drain had settled, so it could pass despite cycle-by-cycle flag timing mismatches.
